Catch Events

General Concept: Catch Events in BPMN are elements that wait for and handle events that must be caught for the process to continue, such as Start Events, Intermediate Catch Events, and Boundary Events. These elements ensure correct event subscriptions, correlation, and variable scoping for all catch event types.

  • Start Event
  • Intermediate Catch Event
  • Boundary Event

Usage & Options in TaktX:
Catch Events in TaktX:

  • Wait for triggers such as messages, timers, signals, or errors to continue the process.
  • Support event subscriptions and correlation for message events.
  • Enable input variable mapping using FEEL expressions for event data extraction.
  • Provide error handling and process interruption if an event is not caught.
  • Allow monitoring and audit logging of event handling and process continuation.
  • Can be used for process start, pause, or boundary event handling.
